title: Evangelist Cohort Launch Choreography & Release-Notes Translation Matrix
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Create a repeatable playbook for launching a small ‘evangelist’ customer cohort (10–20 lighthouse accounts) during beta. This ticket coordinates cross-functional tasks: synced release notes, customer-facing enablement materials, a lightweight success scorecard, and a targeted GTM roadshow for early references. Deliverables: 1) Cohort briefing kit, 2) localized release-notes translation matrix + one-pager, 3) ops handoff checklist for support/CS, 4) post-launch feedback cadence and quality gates.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort briefing kit created and approved by PM and Solutions Engineering
Release notes matrix completed for EN/DE/FR and linked in the kit
Support runbook and escalation matrix published to Confluence with SLA expectations
At least two lighthouse customers scheduled for live walkthroughs and NPS check at week 2
Success scorecard (uptime, p99 latency, feature usage, qualitative feedback) defined and dashboarded
tasks: Draft cohort briefing kit (value props, sample prompts, success metrics)
Coordinate with Docs to produce a TL;DR release notes one-pager for execs and CS
Create release-notes translation matrix and assign owners for EN/DE/FR copy
Schedule product roadshow sessions for top 12 candidate customers
Author support runbook: triage steps, known issues, hotfix rollback criteria
Set up feedback intake in linear-form + spreadsheet for qualitative themes
Define and instrument success scorecard metrics in console dashboard

risk: Primary risk is translation delay and mismatch between release-notes language and in-product strings which could confuse customers. Mitigation: staged communications (EN first), and a hotfix window for copy updates; ensure SEs have a script for walk-throughs.
communication_plan: Week -2: Internal webinar for Sales/CS/Support (recording + FAQ)
Week -1: Release-notes one-pager shared with lighthouse accounts; SE outreach to schedule walkthroughs
Day 0: In-product banner + link to detailed notes (EN), support standby during first 6 hours
Week 1: Collect qualitative feedback via short forms and scheduled interviews
Week 2: NPS check and operational health review; decide go/no-go for broader beta expansion
rollout_phases: Phase A (Pilot): 5 evangelist customers, heavy SE hand-holding, EN notes only
Phase B (Lighthouse): broaden to 15 accounts, translations live in DE/FR, enablement kits distributed
Phase C (Expansion): Post-success gates met, prepare public release notes and GTM campaign
